name: Habakkuk
summary: A prophet who asked the LORD how long violence would go unpunished, waited for His answer, and ended rejoicing in the LORD though every crop should fail. Scripture tells nothing more about him and names no one else alongside him.

key_moments.title: Asks the LORD How Long He Must Cry
key_moments.description: Habakkuk asked the LORD how long he must cry about violence without being heard. The LORD answered that He was raising up the Chaldeans, a bitter and hasty nation, and Habakkuk asked why God held His tongue while the wicked devoured.

key_moments.title: Told to Write the Vision Plainly
key_moments.description: Habakkuk stood on his watchtower to see what the LORD would say. The LORD told him to write the vision plainly on tablets and wait for it though it tarry, for the just shall live by his faith.

key_moments.title: Rejoices in the LORD Though Crops Fail
key_moments.description: Habakkuk heard the LORD and trembled. Yet he said that though the fig tree did not blossom and the fields gave no food, he would rejoice in the LORD, the God of his salvation and his strength.
